device.modelDescription: Main-thread validation fixture (test/sandbox/41): on request, its worker turns off its own validation where module code can reach it.

actionList.name: take
actionList.description: Counts a run and returns its input's n.

actionList.name: give
actionList.description: Returns a valid output, or one its schema refuses.

actionList.name: count
actionList.description: How many times take ran, and whether this worker's own validation has been turned off.

actionList.name: tamper
actionList.description: Turns off this worker's own validation where module code can reach it.
